message.content:
Painting the Eiffel Tower is a massive undertaking that involves thousands of workers, specialized equipment, and strict safety protocols. In practice, the entire process—from preparation and primer application to the final coat—takes roughly **two years**. This timeline includes:

| Phase | Approximate Duration |
|-------|----------------------|
| Surface prep & cleaning | 3–4 months |
| Primer application | 2–3 months |
| First coat of paint | 3–4 months |
| Second coat (finishing) | 2–3 months |
| Final inspection & touch‑ups | 1–2 months |

These estimates assume a continuous, full‑time effort under optimal weather conditions. In reality, weather delays, logistical challenges, and safety inspections can extend the schedule. Nonetheless, the two‑year figure is widely cited by the maintenance team at the Eiffel Tower and aligns with the typical repaint cycle of the monument.
